name: Margaret Agatha Quinn (Osborne)
sources: Ancestry.com, public member tree "Quinn Family Tree" (tree 11167102)
notes: Child of John Bernard Quinn and Emily Mariam Lynn, per the Quinn Family Tree on Ancestry.
